open: In the name of Allah. Assalamu alaikum, my dears. Come closer, tonight’s story is very beautiful.
s1a: Noah, Ilyas, have you ever received news so surprising that you could hardly believe it? Tonight I’ll tell you about news like that, brought by very special guests: good news of a child.
s1c: Get warm and cosy, my dears… Tonight I’ll tell you about the Prophet Ishaq, peace be upon him, the son of Ibrahim and the younger brother of Ismail.
s2a: Allah saved Ibrahim and brought him to the blessed land, and his wife Sarah was with him. Ibrahim had a son, Ismail, far away in the valley of Makkah. But Sarah had not had a child, and they had both become very old.
s2c: The Qur’an doesn’t tell us that, my dear, and what we don’t know, we don’t make up. But we know for sure that Ibrahim always trusted Allah, and that nothing is impossible for Allah.
s3a: Allah says: “And certainly did Our messengers come to Abraham with good tidings; they said, ‘Peace.’ He said, ‘Peace,’ and did not delay in bringing them a roasted calf.” “And placed it near them; he said, ‘Will you not eat?’”
s3b: But they did not eat: “But when he saw their hands not reaching for it, he distrusted them and felt from them apprehension. They said, ‘Fear not. We have been sent to the people of Lot.’” They were angels.
s3d: Yes, my dear. And now listen carefully: “And his wife was standing, and she smiled. Then We gave her good tidings of Ishaq and after Ishaq, Yaqub.”
s4a: His wife was very amazed, and “She said, ‘Woe to me! Shall I give birth while I am an old woman and this, my husband, is an old man? Indeed, this is an amazing thing.’” That means: how can I have a baby when I am old and my husband is an old man?
s4b: A very old woman having a baby? Is that possible?
s4c: The angels said: “Are you amazed at the decree of Allah? May the mercy of Allah and His blessings be upon you, people of the house. Indeed, He is Praiseworthy and Honorable.” When Allah wills something, it happens, and nothing is impossible for Him.
s4d: Ibrahim was amazed too: “He said, ‘Have you given me good tidings although old age has come upon me? Then of what wonder do you inform?’” “They said, ‘We have given you good tidings in truth, so do not be of the despairing.’” That means: those who lose hope. “He said, ‘And who despairs of the mercy of his Lord except for those astray?’”
s5a: And Allah’s promise came true: Sarah had a boy, Ishaq. And Ibrahim prayed: “Praise to Allah, who has granted to me in old age Ismail and Ishaq. Indeed, my Lord is the Hearer of supplication.”
s5c: Yes, Ismail and Ishaq, and both became prophets. “And We gave him good tidings of Isaac, a prophet from among the righteous.” And Allah blessed him and Ishaq.
s6a: And Allah praises Ibrahim, Ishaq and Yaqub in the Qur’an: “And remember Our servants, Abraham, Isaac and Jacob – those of strength and religious vision.” “And We made them leaders guiding by Our command. And We inspired to them the doing of good deeds, establishment of prayer, and giving of zakah; and they were worshippers of Us.”
s6b: And Yaqub? Did he come, like the angels said?
s6c: Yes! Ishaq had a son, Yaqub, who became a prophet, and Yaqub’s son Yusuf was a prophet too. Our Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, said: “The noble, son of the noble, son of the noble, son of the noble: Yusuf, son of Yaqub, son of Ishaq, son of Ibrahim.”
s6d: Four prophets in a row, like a chain!
s6e: Like a shining chain, my dear. Allah placed prophethood and the Book among the descendants of Ibrahim, and from the descendants of Ismail came our Prophet Muhammad, peace and blessings be upon him. And all of them called people to worship Allah alone.
s7a: They’ve fallen asleep… My dears, never despair of Allah’s mercy, for nothing is impossible for Allah. When Allah gives you something good, say like Ibrahim: Alhamdulillah. And be like Ishaq: do good, pray, and give to others.
s7b: And next time, I’ll tell you about Yaqub… and about the important question he asked his sons at the end of his life. And you, watching us right now: if you liked the story, ask your parents to subscribe to our channel, so you don’t miss the next story.
close: And you, dear fathers and mothers: subscribe to our channel, and share these stories with the people you love, so that together we pass on the beautiful message of Islam to our children.
final: Good night, my dears. I entrust you to Allah, with whom nothing entrusted is ever lost.
